dominant: vīra with adbhuta weight (lineage pride; marvel of descent)
sthayibhava: utsāha (the tradition's onward drive) steadied into dhṛti
justification: The ahnika drives forward — studied, divided, descended, lapsed, restored, housed — and each drive lands; wonder at the sheer scale (crores, kings, maṭhikās) crowns the pride, and the work's own flowing (v15) turns energy into rest.
